disclaimer: Prices are approximate India street/online ranges (2025–2026) and change often. Skills before spend — finish Shared fundamentals with laptop + headphones first.

tiers.title: ₹0 — Start today
items: Laptop or desktop you already own
Any headphones or earbuds you have (volume carefully)
One free DAW: LMMS, Cakewalk (Windows), or Waveform Free
tiers.note: You can reach first mix and first track on this tier.

tiers.title: ~₹2–5k — Better headphones
items: Closed-back practice headphones (Audio-Technica / Sony / similar entry models)
Optional: simple Y-splitter if sharing with a phone
tiers.note: Closed-backs help cue mixing and night practice without leaking as much.

tiers.title: ~₹5–15k — First hardware step
items: USB audio interface for cleaner monitoring and mic/line in
Still optional — software practice comes first
tiers.note: Buy only after you enjoy daily practice for a few weeks.

tiers.title: ~₹25–40k — When you are ready
items: Or a stronger interface + monitors later
Budget for cables, stands, and hearing protection
tiers.note: Worth it when you know you will keep DJing or producing — not Day 1.

principles: One tool at a time — don't buy a studio you won't use
Protect hearing: moderate volume, breaks every 60 minutes
Prefer official stores and known marketplaces; avoid cracked software 'deals'
